title: Specifications for reading and execution
summary: JSON expresses the requirements. A readable document explains them. Focused context supports delivery of each task.
goals: Reduce writing and review of repetitive structures.
Make decisions, requirements and their evidence easy to find.
users: Feature owners reviewing and approving a feature.
Agents implementing a task with the relevant context.
constraints: Reading a document requires no hosted service.
No automatic commits, pushes or publication.
Planned checks are never presented as observed results.

requirements.title: A standalone document
requirements.description: Open the PRD from a local file without a server or network access.
acceptance: Text and diagrams remain readable offline.

requirements.title: JSON as the single source
requirements.description: Generate headings, references and dependencies without writing a second document.
acceptance: Unknown references and cycles are rejected.

requirements.title: Relevant context for each task
requirements.description: Extract the requirements and contracts needed for a single task.

requirements.title: Evidence separate from the plan
requirements.description: Attach observed results to the exact approved revision.
acceptance: An edited PRD invalidates the previous execution record.
A check that has not run remains marked as planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible pull request preparation
requirements.description: Collect the diff, fill in the template and check scope before publication.
acceptance: Tests without evidence are not reported as passing.
Planning documents are detected before publication.

requirements.title: Reliable review mechanics
requirements.description: Prepare the diff once and aggregate structured reviewer responses.
acceptance: A missing or malformed response remains visible.
Lines outside the diff are not presented as anchored comments.

requirements.title: Accessible and comfortable reading
requirements.description: The reader adapts to narrow screens and printing. Controls have visible focus and content does not depend on animation.
acceptance: No horizontal page overflow at 375 px.

tasks.title: Define the document contract
tasks.goal: Validate identifiers, references and the graph.
validation: Exercise a cycle and an unknown reference.

tasks.title: Build the HTML reader
validation: Open offline, navigate with the keyboard and print.

tasks.title: Extract context and track evidence
tasks.goal: Link excerpts and results to source documents.

tasks.title: Automate pull request preparation
tasks.goal: Build a description from a fixed Git snapshot.
validation: Use a temporary repository with a stacked branch.

tasks.title: Automate Argus review mechanics
tasks.goal: Validate and aggregate without hiding errors.
validation: Exercise a missing response and a line outside the diff.

tasks.title: Review the document end to end
steps: Open the HTML on a desktop and then on a narrow screen.
Follow a requirement to its task and check.
Switch to the dark theme, then print.
tasks.expected: The document remains understandable without knowing its JSON structure.

risks.description: An overly detailed schema could increase the amount of writing.
risks.mitigation: Keep explanations in prose and measure excerpts on a representative case.
